translations.web: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.
translations.bsb: Yet in hearing all these words, the king and his servants did not become frightened or tear their garments.
translations.kjv: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
translations.asv: And they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
